text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Aoi Stakes, and I'm worried about how busy Curren Chan has been posting on all of her social media. What if it affects her performance today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Curren Chan cutely declares that her performance will take all of my worries away.
